concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-subscription-retry-charge-node]] - Node.js manual retry of a past-due subscription charge, with the explicit example amount, displayed success access, and separate transaction-settlement submission route
warnings: Keep the operation scoped to manual retry of a past-due subscription; do not infer automatic retries, retry cadence, status transitions, or later billing behavior.
Treat "24.00" as the explicit amount used by the examples only; the page does not establish currency, a default or omitted-amount behavior, or whether it is the full past-due balance.
Do not assign undocumented semantics to the unlabeled third argument `true`, and do not treat either displayed `success` comment as proof of settlement completion or payment finality.

Describe the manual settlement branch as the displayed sequence: after retry success, submit the returned transaction ID for settlement; do not infer downstream settlement state or subscription lifecycle effects.
